title: Admin Profile
description: This project adds the functionality to both play and moderate a server while retaining data (e.g., inventory, health, etc.) for creative and survival game modes.
body:
# Admin Profile
**With this plugin, you can moderate and play your survival games without worrying about data getting mixed up!**
## Features
1. **The inventory with the NBT tags for each item**
1. **The number of hearts**
1. **The hunger rate**
1. **The amount of XP**
1. **The position before each game mode change**
1. **the height of the fall when you’re in survival mode**

## Command

```
/ap teleport
```
This command prevents you from being teleported every time the game mode changes. Once enabled, it will teleport you to the last saved position.

## Config
In the settings, you can choose whether or not to disable the settings you want for everyone
